annotations.title: Undo the last change to a DIYA-GL book

description: Takes back a change to the open DIYA-GL book by saving an earlier version as the next version: by default the version before the latest, or toVersion. Answers the book's summary, the version restored and the figures that moved. Use this when the person says a change was wrong. The undo is a version too, so another undo takes it back. It does not file anything.

toVersion.description: The version to go back to; defaults to the one before the latest
